summary: EDISS is a two-year Erasmus Mundus master's in engineering data-intensive intelligent software systems, run by Åbo Akademi University in Finland, the University of the Balearic Islands, the University of L'Aquila and Mälardalen University in Sweden. Erasmus Mundus scholarships are worth €51,600 and EDISS scholarships €31,320. The scholarship round runs from 16 November 2026 to 12 January 2027.
meta_title: EDISS 2027: Erasmus Mundus software engineering scholarship
meta_description: EDISS pays fees and €1,400 a month for a software engineering master's in Finland, Spain, Italy and Sweden. Scholarship round closes 12 January 2027.
covers: Erasmus Mundus scholarship: participation costs of €9,000 a year plus €1,400 a month for 24 months, €51,600 in all.
EDISS scholarship: the €9,000 yearly fee waived, €800 a month in the first year and €310 a month in the second, €31,320 in all.
Tuition waiver scholarship (later round): €18,000 of fees waived, with no allowance.
Self-funded students pay €9,000 a year. Travel, visa and housing are never included.
eligibility: A bachelor's degree of at least 180 ECTS in computer science, software engineering or an equivalent subject. IT work experience does not make up for missing theory.

English: IELTS Academic 6.5 with no part below 6.0 (the online IELTS is not accepted) or TOEFL iBT 93. The exemption covers only English-taught degrees completed on site in Australia, Canada, New Zealand, the UK, the US, Switzerland or the EU, so applicants from Ghana or Nigeria need a test.
how_to_apply: Round 1, for Erasmus Mundus and EDISS scholarships: 16 November 2026 at 8:00 to 12 January 2027 at 15:00, Helsinki time. Attachments can be updated until 19 January 2027 at 15:00.

Upload a certified bachelor's certificate and transcript with translations, the grading scale, the English test report, your passport, the EDISS CV template, two academic recommendation letters and a two-minute motivation video.
Round 2 (25 February to 11 March 2027) is for tuition waivers only, and round 3 (6 to 15 April 2027) for self-funded students.
watch_out: Applicants with degrees from African countries must have their transcripts mailed by the university in a sealed envelope, arriving by 30 July 2027 at 15:00 Helsinki time.
Studies start in August 2027, earlier than most master's.
Only round 1 offers the scholarships with a monthly allowance.
documents: Certified bachelor's certificate with English translation
Transcript with CGPA and grading scale

faq.q: When is the EDISS scholarship deadline?
faq.a: Round 1 closes on 12 January 2027 at 15:00 Helsinki time. It opens on 16 November 2026.

faq.q: What is the difference between the Erasmus Mundus and EDISS scholarships?
faq.a: Both waive the €9,000 yearly fee. Erasmus Mundus adds €1,400 a month for 24 months; EDISS adds €800 a month in the first year and €310 in the second.

faq.q: Do Ghanaian applicants need IELTS for EDISS?
faq.a: Yes. The exemption only covers English-taught degrees completed in Australia, Canada, New Zealand, the UK, the US, Switzerland or the EU.
